Vulnerability: Lack of employee awareness and insufficient authentication controls
Existing Controls: Basic antivirus; password authentication; informal awareness training
Recommended Controls: Security awareness training; Multi-factor authentication (MFA); Email filtering

Vulnerability: Backup restoration is not regularly tested
Existing Controls: Backups are maintained; restoration is not regularly tested
Recommended Controls: Regular backup restoration testing; Offline or isolated backups; Endpoint protection; Patch management

Vulnerability: Excessive access privileges and limited monitoring
Recommended Controls: Role-based access control; Least privilege; Access logging; Periodic access reviews

Vulnerability: Inconsistent MFA and potential password reuse
Existing Controls: Password-based authentication; MFA not consistently enabled
Recommended Controls: Multi-factor authentication; Strong password policy; Password manager; Account monitoring

Existing Controls: Software patching is performed but not formally managed
Recommended Controls: Centralized patch management; Vulnerability scanning; Software inventory; Patch prioritization

Vulnerability: Multiple potential attack paths including compromised accounts and vulnerable systems
Recommended Controls: Data access controls; MFA; Encryption; Security monitoring; Incident response procedures
